facts.text: The University of Wyoming offers the Newe & Hinono'ei Scholarship (formerly the Wind River Promise) to cover tuition and fees for enrolled members of the Eastern Shoshone Tribe or Northern Arapaho Tribe.

sources.title: University of Wyoming Newe & Hinono'ei Scholarship
sources.quote: This fund, formerly called Wind River Promise, was created to provide scholarships to help support undergraduate students at the University of Wyoming who are enrolled members of the Eastern Shoshone Tribe or the Northern Arapaho Tribe.
